Garage description
Purchase this paint to become a fan of this clan and support it in the playoff stage of the tournament. The paint will be removed from your Garage before the playoffs of the next tournament. Important! Upon purchasing this paint, you will no longer be able to purchase the other three fan paints.
See also: Paints
Interesting facts
The paint was available for purchase from June 4 to June 15, 2021, for 10 tankoins as part of the second {GAME}Sport 2021 series tournament.
Banguins ended up in second place in the {GAME}Sport Season 2 tournament.
Note
This paint is still available in the garages of players who have previously obtained it.
